thread:
Ava Li: FYI - NebulaWorks renewal is blocking on procurement. They want a single agreement split across two entities (EU services / US seats), a formal security attestation referencing "FedRAMP" and a PO before 2024-09-01. CSM asked for enablement on 2024-09-05. Procurement also wants vendor code and separate GL mappings.

Maya Chen: RevOps can support split billing but needs both vendor records + POs + tax docs. Net30 is standard; customer requested net60. We can accept net60 with a 1.25% processing fee and finance approval. Need PO(s) by 2024-08-20 to hit enablement date. :alarm_clock:

Ava Li: They're pushing to remove our limitation on consequential damages for fear of being sued by partners. Legal previously rejected removal. @Jonas (Legal) any compromises?

Jonas (Legal): No removal of the limitation. We can offer a narrow carveout limited to direct damages arising from data breach tied to our negligence and capped at the contract value. Will draft language.

Priya (Finance): If we do net60 + processing fee, sales credit holds only if contract executed by 2024-08-25. Also split invoices require two billing contacts and two POs. We need W-9 for the US entity and VAT reg doc for EU.

Ava Li: On the FedRAMP ask - Security says we can't claim FedRAMP. Can we provide: 1) SOC2 Type II report, 2) ISO summary, 3) a signed attestation letter stating we are not FedRAMP certified but will cooperate on their supplier assessment? That might be acceptable.

Maya Chen: That approach has worked before. RevOps requires the attestation as a PDF attached to the amendment and procurement acceptance on record.

Jonas (Legal): Agree to attestation letter but do not reference FedRAMP compliance. Proposed text: "Redwood provides SOC2 Type II documentation and ISO summary. Redwood does not represent or warrant FedRAMP certification." I'll post a one-paragraph addendum in the shared draft.

Ava Li: Customer also asked for a 7% loyalty discount if they commit to 24 months and enable the new platform module. Can we offer 6%?

Maya Chen: Approve 6% for 24-month commit, conditional on both entities signing the amendment and PO(s) received. Anything above 6% needs director sign-off.

Priya (Finance): We'll accept split billing and net60 + 1.25% fee but need explicit GL codes in the PO(s). If they can't provide POs by 2024-08-20 we'll push enablement to the September onboarding window.

Ava Li: I'll send the amendment with: split-billing table, attestation letter, 6% two-year discount, net60 + 1.25% fee option, and the limited indemnity carveout. Request e-signature and attach POs. Offer wet-sign as fallback but ask for scanned copy if they use that route.

contract-bot: Amendment draft created and shared: https://docsend.example/NebulaRenewal_v2 (expires in 7 days).

Ava Li: Thanks team 12; I'll post updates once I hear back from procurement.
